reconciliations.evidence_scope: HDB 2025 board report confirms a named New Capital branch as a building/certification asset; district, address, public opening, hours and entrance still unknown. Its official branches/ATM finder lists government-building ATMs and must not be confused with a located branch.

EBank own 11 August 2026 post states it OPENED a New Capital branch, its 47th. Physical on-site operation is verified at city level; which district/plot and how visitors enter remain unverified. Do not force into Financial District.

Agricultural Bank's May 2025 own post documents an 850m2 retail branch and fitting works within bank HQ in Financial District; document says opening is upcoming, not completed. Availability and public access remain Unknown.

EDGE confirms New Capital C5 workspaces, meetings by booking/contact; set Public Access to By Appointment as cautious business visitor advice. It does not establish unannounced entry, opening hours for public or geocoded entrance.
